calculation_handling.description: Despite 10.5.75.1(4), a solar energy device on a garden suite building must comply with the minimum building setbacks for a garden suite building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Incorporates the garden suite building setbacks (150.7.60.20) for the device; read as INCLUDE rather than REQUIRE because no vocab.requirement token fits. Solar devices are not part of the envelope calculation.

calculation_handling.description: No part of a solar energy device on a garden suite building may be more than 1.2 m above the permitted maximum height for that building.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 1.2 m is a projection allowance above the building's permitted height; there is no DSL target for a device height, so it is recorded as threshold_used_in_application (closest closed reason) and the unit as a PERMIT of the projection.

150.7.75.1(1).explanation: Solar panels on a garden suite must respect the garden suite's setbacks and may rise no more than 1.2 m above the garden suite's height limit.
